question.text: Which of the following entities serve as Registrar and Transfer Agents (RTAs) for mutual funds in India and also operate investor service centers where transactions can be processed?

explanation.text: The Logic: RTAs maintain investor records, and their offices function as Investor Service Centres (ISCs) for documentation and transaction processing (workbook p. 69). CAMS and KFintech are identified as the two Qualified RTAs serving the mutual fund industry in India (workbook p. 220). The Trap: NSDL and CDSL are depositories for securities, not mutual fund RTAs (workbook p. 72). NSE and BSE are stock exchanges providing transaction platforms, not RTAs (workbook p. 118). AMFI is the industry association and SEBI is the regulator; neither performs the RTA function. Note: Because each RTA services multiple AMCs, an investor visiting a CAMS or KFintech office can transact in any scheme serviced by that RTA.
